claim_1.claim: Transcription profiling by array analysis of whole blood from 15 YF17D-vaccinated individuals showed significant modulation of 594 genes, including up-regulation of IFN-induced genes (IFI27, IFI30, G1P2, G1P3, OAS1-3) and TLR-associated genes (TLR7, MYD88, IRF7), at days 3 and 7 post-vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.section: Vaccination with YF17D rapidly and transiently induces modulation of genes associated with multiple pathways
sources.quote: Expression profiles of 594 genes were found to change significantly between day 0 and any time point after vaccination. The peak of modulation of gene expression primarily occurred at days 3 and 7 after vaccination.

claim_2.claim: Transcription profiling by array analysis of whole blood from 15 YF17D-vaccinated individuals showed up-regulation of complement system components (C1QA, C1QB, C3AR1, SERPING1) and NK cell-associated genes (KIR2DL3, KIR2DL4, PRF1, GNLY, GZMB) early after vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.section: Vaccination with YF17D rapidly and transiently induces modulation of genes associated with multiple pathways
sources.quote: Components of the complement system (C1QA, C1QB, C3AR1, and SERPING1) were found to be up-regulated in blood cells early after vaccination.
